lines: The demonic creatures that had been frozen by the ice claws shattered with a satisfying sound.
Using her outstanding physical abilities, Onizaki Kirara slaughtered the demonic creatures one after another.
(Yeahー!! I can fight by myself without having to listen to the orders of a guy like that!!)
He had been complaining about something, but I wasn't going to listen to him.
Who could trust a guy like him, who was out of breath from defeating a single Will-o'-wisp?
When appointing me to this mission, Igawa Asagi had told me...
I've heard about you and your mother's past.
I think it was a terribly heartbreaking event, and I completely understand your rejection of men. Howeverー
It's not good for you to be hung up on that forever either.
ーSo for your next mission, try to cooperate with him.
Perhaps interacting with him can be the catalyst for letting go of your pastー
(ーSo she wants me to rely on that sort of guy?)
(Even if it's Asagi-sensei saying it, I can't go along with that!!)
I was rebelling precisely because I had been told to do it like that.
I had snapped at himーat Fuma Kotaroーfor no reason, made fun of him, and tried to think of him as insignificant.
It didn't matter what Headmistress Asagi had said.
They were all "enemies" not worthy of trustー
(Trust them and I'll end up like mom...!!)
For a short moment in the fight, I lost my composure. And thenー
There was someone who didn't fail to notice that opening.
I shouted as I fought back against the demonic creatures.
For some reason, Kirara-senpai's movements had faltered for a momentー
The ground swelled up at her feet and an enormous, muscular man appeared.
GUHUHUHUH!! Your defense is porous, little lady!!!
This was the role that the Shadows had played during the "Crossroad of Confusion."
The person controlling the horde of demonic creatures had been waiting for an opening to strike.
She had avoided an attack in her blind spot which would normally have been impossible to dodge, and immediately got in a counterattack.
Pierced by her icy claws, the large man's body dissolved into a muddy substance, becoming a mere lump of earth and tumbling in a heap. And thenー
GUHUHUH, too bad, little lady. That wasn't the right meー!!
Once again, the man emerged behind her unguarded back and unleashed a powerful blow with his stout armー
The gigantic, musclebound fist sunk into Kirara-senpai's midsection.
She was slammed against the wall and immediately flopped to the ground awkwardly.
Kirara-senpai's pretty face was contorted in pain and she coughed up a huge amount of blood.
Well then, little lady, it's time for the denouementー!!!
The massive man leapt toward the fallen, unmoving Kirara-senpai.
